text: 2.04 Territorial Jurisdiction of RA Territorial jurisdiction of RAs is given in Appendix 1A of Appendices and Aayat Niryat Forms. The address of applicant determines the jurisdiction of RA. Each application, unless otherwise specified, shall be submitted to jurisdictional RA. pg. 11 CHAPTER-2 GENERAL PROVISIONS REGARDING IMPORTS AND EXPORTS
